description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogItemsSpecification class in the application core specifications, verifying filtering logic for catalog items based on specified IDs using mocked CatalogItem objects.

classes.name: CatalogItemsSpecification
classes.description: Unit test class that tests the behavior of the CatalogItemsSpecification class, particularly its filtering capabilities for catalog items based on provided IDs.

methods.name: MatchesSpecificCatalogItem
methods.description: Test to verify that the specification correctly filters and matches a specific catalog item with ID 1.

methods.name: MatchesAllCatalogItems
methods.description: Test to verify that the specification correctly matches multiple catalog items with IDs 1 and 3.

methods.name: GetTestCollection
methods.description: Helper method that creates and returns a list of mocked CatalogItem objects for use in tests.
